This implies a possible pathway where Paraminabeolide D may influence cyclin-D1 activity, which in turn affects the function of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The evidence suggests a chain of interactions, but the strength of the relationship is partially supported by the final score of 0.5451, indicating some level of confidence in the observed correlations.
